title: Hanford 222-S Laboratory halves sample turnaround while handling a fourfold 2025 workload
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports that the 222-S Laboratory reduced average sample-to-result time from about 180 days to less than 90 days over five years, added or modernized 29 instruments, and kept pace when workload increased fourfold in 2025. Denominator: Average sample-to-result turnaround over the five-year modernization period; the 2025 workload comparison and a separate two-to-three-day-to-three-hour separation method are distinct measures.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports that the 222-S Laboratory reduced average sample-to-result time from about 180 days to less than 90 days over five years, added or modernized 29 instruments, and kept pace when workload increased fourfold in 2025.
